observed: Four complete 100-pattern runs each reported FCB=0x000f0002 and word_errors=0, half_errors=0, low_errors=0, high_errors=0, upper_byte_mutations=0, foreign_half_mutations=0, foreign_word_mutations=0, overwrite_errors=0, reset_initial=0000, reset_asserted=0000 and reset_released=0000. The promoted composer emitted the byte-identical tested bitstream and passed once more; the retained word/byte control then passed 100/100.
implementation: HSIZE0 uses its vendor-exact BufMUX03->InputMUX03->RMUX41->IMUX15 ingress. The first existing selector LUT computes !HADDR1 && (HADDR0 || HSIZE1 || HSIZE0), and the existing buffer LUT qualifies that predecode with HTRANS1 after moving only HTRANS1's exclusive high-request sink to a three-pip conflict-free physical branch. The downstream HWRITE/write-ready/reset handshake, one-wait controller, sixteen capture cells and HRDATA exits are retained. Strict pack reports 471 data pips, 353 block-clean, 25 relative-clean and zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors.
controls: An HREADY-safe forced-zero HSIZE0 scout produced sticky mask 0x000; an otherwise identical HSIZE0 identity scout produced exactly 0x002, meaning only aligned halfword +0 asserted across 64 patterns for each of nine transfer classes. The full oracle uses real sw/sh/sb instructions and verifies word, aligned halfword, independent byte, rejection and reset behavior.
scope: Qualifies one exact L48 16-bit held-scratch composition for aligned 32-bit word writes at +0, aligned 16-bit halfword writes at +0, independent 8-bit writes at +0/+1, rejection of byte +2/+3, rejection of aligned halfword +2/+4/+8/+c, rejection of aligned word +4/+8/+c, overwrite/hold/readback, one wait and GPIO4.1 synchronous reset. Reads at foreign offsets still alias +0. Misaligned transfers, HRDATA[31:16], bursts, arbitrary placement/width, a generic bank generator and integration with the public ID/counter/W1C bank remain unqualified.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint now has silicon-qualified aligned word, aligned halfword and independent byte storage semantics plus write-offset isolation. Read-address decoding is the next protocol gap; this remains an exact checkpoint, not a generic 16-bit register-bank claim.
next_experiment: Gate the exact HRDATA[15:0] exits with the qualified HADDR[3:2] read phase so foreign reads return zero without disturbing the retained write path.
